text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Intestinal Atresia (likely Jejunal or Ileal).

The clinical picture of an 8-month-old with bilious vomiting, abdominal distension, tenderness, and an X-ray showing dilated bowel with an air-filled cutoff (absence of gas in the rectum) is classic for a complete intestinal obstruction. Given the severity and the lack of distal gas, surgical intervention is indicated immediately.
